notes.title: Happy Bird Day
notes.notes:
[h2]Happy Bird Day[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740246/40b9fab187d857004457c56ede3a1d64cd5c9ac7.png[/img]

[b]Happy bird day[/b] – is a game about funny hopping birds searching for seeds and exploring the vast world. Grab your friend and go into a world of fun and joy. You'll have to make an effort to complete this unforgettable adventure.

[h2]Co-op[/h2]
The game is based on two-player co-op. Here, you will need to work together to help two birds reach their desired goal. But what exactly will you have to face?
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740246/7f40b562029a8b96397af4616f07e007ed6118fb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740246/0f5094653b40d3b801266f24544c17879a9c0745.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Solo[/h2]
Beat levels, race against the clock, collect seeds, overcome obstacles:  jump over pits, dodge thorns and don't trust absolutely every single animal that comes on your way (｡•ᴗ-)｡
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740246/3407ef0b58ddfbc1010696c29e2a643dc3d5e97b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44740246/ab0c90aa2c3f3f0ed3528a729a899fdcbc03b94e.png[/img][/url]

[h2][/h2]
[b][i]Hurry up. The birds are eager to set off on their journey. They're waiting for you![/i][/b]
